title: Agility Robotics is set to begin trading on the Nasdaq under AGLT after a SPAC merger, the first dedicated humanoid robotics company to go public in the US (Samantha Kelly/Bloomberg)
summary: Samantha Kelly / Bloomberg: Agility Robotics is set to begin trading on the Nasdaq under AGLT after a SPAC merger, the first dedicated humanoid robotics company to go public in the US — Agility Robotics Inc. is set to become the first dedicated humanoid company to go public in the US, marking a major milestone …
